data.gender_notes: Raheman is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Raheman is a Hindu name that means 'Protector, Guardian, God'. This name is derived from the Arabic word 'Rahman' which means 'Most Gracious, Most Merciful, Benevolent'. In Hinduism, this name is associated with the deity Rahu, the North Node of the Moon, which is considered a protector and guardian in astrology. Raheman is a powerful name that evokes a sense of protection, strength, and divine grace.
data.spiritual_meaning: Raheman is a spiritual name that represents the divine protection and guidance of God. It is a name that inspires faith, devotion, and a deep connection to the divine. Raheman is a name that can be used to invoke the power and blessings of the deity Rahu, or to remind oneself of the protective and nurturing presence of God.
